chosen_system.why_chosen: Only system found in this session where effective diffusivity (FRAP), free/local diffusivity (FCS), extracellular clearance (FDAP) and a measured protein distribution from a defined source were all reported in one open-access paper, same organism, same stage window, same fusion-protein family. It is NOT a fin system.

audit_table.assay: FRAP of uniformly expressed fusion protein, fitted with a production-diffusion-clearance model in 3D embryo-like geometry; clearance constrained by FDAP k1
audit_table.uncertainty: standard error (Fig. 4E legend); n BMP2b-Dendra2 = 6, BMP2b-sfGFP = 8
audit_table.quote: We found effective diffusion coefficients of 2-3 um2/s for BMPs (BMP2b-Dendra2: 2.0 +/- 0.4 um2/s; BMP2b-sfGFP: 2.6 +/- 0.7 um2/s ...) and of 6-7 um2/s for Chordin (Chordin-Dendra2: 6.0 +/- 0.7 um2/s; Chordin-sfGFP: 7.3 +/- 3.9 um2/s)
audit_table.organism_stage_tissue: zebrafish, blastula stages, whole blastoderm, mRNA-overexpressed fusion proteins
audit_table.caveats: Model-dependent: D is a fit parameter of an SDD model with k1 fixed, so D_eff and k1 are not independent observations. Overexpressed tagged protein, not endogenous.
audit_table.fin_match: No. Fin bud/fin fold is a later-stage, ECM-rich (actinotrichia), bilayered epidermis-over-mesenchyme tissue; tortuosity, HSPG content and receptor density differ.

audit_table.assay: FCS in small extracellular volumes away from cell surfaces, calibrated against Alexa 488 (435 um2/s)
audit_table.quote: BMP2b-sfGFP (free diffusion coefficient: D f = 46 +/- 1 um2/s) and Chordin-sfGFP (free diffusion coefficient: D f = 59 +/- 2 um2/s)
audit_table.caveats: D_free/D_eff = 23 (BMP2b) and 9.8 (Chordin). The gap combines tortuosity / extracellular volume fraction (affects inert tracers too: secreted GFP FCS ~90 vs FRAP ~40 um2/s, Mueller 2013 review, secondary) and ligand-specific binding/uptake. Neither is predicted by a structure.

audit_table.assay: FDAP (fluorescence decrease after Dendra2 photoconversion), single-exponential fit
audit_table.uncertainty: reported +/-; n BMP2b = 22, Chordin = 6 (Fig. 4A+B legend; error bars SD)
audit_table.quote: For BMP2b-Dendra2, we found a clearance rate constant of k 1 = (8.9 +/- 0.1) x 10^-5 /s (half-life 130 min ...). For Chordin-Dendra2, we measured a similar clearance rate constant of k 1 = (9.6 +/- 0.3) x 10^-5 /s (half-life 120 min
audit_table.caveats: Measured on Dendra2 fusions only; sfGFP gradients use the Dendra2 k1. Lumps receptor uptake, degradation and any immobilisation.

audit_table.quantity: Measured gradient extent from a defined source
audit_table.assay: light-sheet imaging of sfGFP gradients from ~50-75 transplanted cells (sphere stage, 5-5.5 hpf hosts)

values.BMP2b-sfGFP: 50 % of maximal at 30-40 um from source boundary, 60 min post-transplant (n=8)

audit_table.uncertainty: range as quoted; per-embryo profiles are in Fig. 3H+I (image, not digitised here)
audit_table.quote: 60 min post-transplantation the BMP2b-sfGFP signal drops to 50% of the maximal concentration at a distance of 30-40 um, whereas the gradient formed by Chordin-sfGFP reaches 50% of its maximal concentration at a distance of 50-60 um from the source boundary
audit_table.caveats: Transient, not steady state (k1*t = 0.32 at 60 min), so lambda = sqrt(D/k) does not apply directly. This is the natural held-out observable. Fluorescent-protein maturation time and receptor saturation near the source are not accounted for in sdd_check.py.

can: a 3D coordinate hypothesis for a monomer or complex, with model-internal confidence (pLDDT, PAE, pTM/ipTM)

a hydrodynamic radius estimate via a separate hydrodynamics calculation (e.g. HYDROPRO) only if the structure is confident and glycosylation/tags are modelled; this bounds D_free in water, not D_eff in tissue
candidate interface residues to design binding mutants for a wet-lab test
cannot: D_eff in tissue (set by tortuosity, ECS fraction, binding to HSPG/receptors)
what_structure_prediction_can_supply.binding_models: Docking/complex prediction (Boltz-2, AF3-type) or a ddG predictor gives a geometry or a relative score. It becomes evidence for Kd only after calibration against measured Kd for the same protein family (e.g. SPR/BLI of BMP-Chordin or FGF-FGFR) with a pre-set error bound and a negative control. The project's own Fgfr2c negative control already failed that test (scored above the cognate pair).

bionemo_decision.reason: The measured gap in the chosen system is D_free/D_eff ~10-23 and depends on tissue hindrance and the source geometry, neither of which a structure model computes. For the fin proteins the project predicted, the dummy-MSA OpenFold2 monomers are low confidence (mean pLDDT 41-56) and the MSA-based improvements are largely template recall. No measured fin transport quantity exists to compare against.
not_justified_until: a matched measurement exists (fin-stage FRAP/FDAP/FCS for the same ligand, or Kd by SPR/BLI for the same pair)
a pre-registered mapping from model output to a measurable quantity (e.g. predicted Rh -> D_free compared with FCS D_free; tolerance set in advance)
a negative control that the model passes

held_out_calibration_design.system: zebrafish blastula BMP2b-sfGFP and Chordin-sfGFP clones (Pomreinke 2017)
held_out_calibration_design.model: source-diffusion-clearance (SDD) in 3D embryo geometry, production in the clone, uniform D and k1
fixed_inputs: clone geometry (needs per-embryo measurement or the authors' mesh)
production rate (free scale; profiles are normalised)
held_out_calibration_design.held_out: gradient profile shape at 60-75 min post-transplant (Fig. 3H+I), never used for fitting
held_out_calibration_design.metric: x50 (distance to 50 % of maximum) and RMS difference of the normalised profile
held_out_calibration_design.tolerance: pre-set: predicted x50 within the reported band widened by x1.5; profile RMS within the between-embryo SE
documented_insufficiency_if: predicted x50 changes by more than the tolerance when the unmeasured clone radius is varied over a plausible range (this is what sdd_check.py shows for a 1D and a spherical surrogate)
the per-embryo profiles cannot be obtained (figure images only)

the gradient-fit D and FRAP D_eff disagree beyond their SE (authors report 4 um2/s from gradient fits vs FRAP 2.0 +/- 0.4 (Dendra2, ~5 SE apart) and 2.6 +/- 0.7 (sfGFP, ~2 SE apart); no SE given for the gradient-fit value, so this is not a demonstrated inconsistency)
held_out_calibration_design.status: designed, not executed with the 3D model
held_out_calibration_design.surrogate_result: 1D planar Dirichlet surrogate fails the pre-set x1.5 tolerance for all constructs (x50 70-132 um vs reported 30-60 um). Spherical Dirichlet surrogate passes or fails depending only on the assumed clone radius R (BMP2b passes for R >= 35 um, Chordin for R >= 50 um). Conclusion: with D_eff and k1 fixed, the held-out observable is controlled by unmeasured source geometry and source kinetics, so a crude surrogate cannot validate or falsify the published values. The authors' own 3D model is reported to agree (Fig. 3-figure supplement 2E-H, not re-run here).

accepted_changes: stated that the Dirichlet source is a surrogate for a volumetric production source (script header and output)
added R=35 um and a stated (unverified) cell-size bound R ~28-42 um
softened the FRAP vs gradient-fit D comparison to SE terms
split D_free/D_eff gap into tortuosity and binding
added sfGFP maturation and receptor-saturation caveats
not_adopted: Gemini's specific numbers for sfGFP maturation half-time and blastomere diameter: not verified against a source, so used only as qualitative caveats
